parallel.requirements: Recognized the executable as age and the need to reimplement encryption/decryption behavior from observed CLI behavior and bundled docs only.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Swarm mode was enabled and the agent wrote a plan to split crypto, format, SSH, recipient, and CLI work, but no subagent or AgentSwarm call executed.
parallel.implementation: Created a Go module and internal package directories, then wrote skeleton interfaces and TODO panics for bech32, hkdf, chacha, scrypt, sha3, mlkem, format, stream, sshkeys, recipients, and wordlist.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: No complete integrated main program or successful final build appears before cancellation; the artifact captured partial source files and the original executable file in the workspace.
parallel.verification: Performed behavioral probes against the bundled age binary and stopped a hung pty probe, but did not reach integrated tests of the reimplementation.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run ended by cancellation after timeout with partial stubs, no executed swarm work, and an official compile_failed evaluation.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same clean-room age CLI reimplementation requirements, including CLI flags, X25519, scrypt, SSH, armor, stream format, and possible PQ/plugin behavior.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Stayed single-agent as required by serial mode, using a todo list to sequence probing, primitives, format, recipients, CLI, interop tests, and compile.sh.
serial.implementation: Created a Go module, wrote bech32 and primitive packages, added ChaCha/Poly1305/HKDF/scrypt tests, and patched scrypt data structures during debugging.
serial.integration_and_delivery: No complete CLI, recipient integration, or compile.sh was delivered before timeout; the artifact only contained partial primitive packages and support files.
serial.verification: Ran `go test ./internal/primitives/`, observed build failures and failing crypto vectors, and compared scrypt expected values against Python hashlib.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run ended by cancellation after timeout with failing primitive tests and an official compile_failed evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the clean-room reverse-engineering task and the age CLI behavior surface.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same clean-room task and a broad age CLI behavior surface.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No substantive requirement-recognition difference; both understood the target, and both failed before completing it.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel planned a swarm decomposition into package-level owners but never launched those owners.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial explicitly stayed with one owner and tracked sequential work through a todo list.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The practical ownership difference is that parallel had an unexecuted delegation plan, while serial used a single-agent implementation plan; neither produced a complete solution.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created interface stubs meant to define package contracts for future delegation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote concrete package APIs as part of its own implementation rather than for child handoff.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's interface work was preparatory for never-started subagents; serial's interfaces were direct local implementation artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented mostly directory structure and stub packages with TODO panics after probing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented more concrete Go code, including bech32, ChaCha/Poly1305/HKDF/scrypt attempts, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial got further into executable implementation, while parallel remained largely at scaffold level before cancellation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel had a background probe that stayed running, was inspected, then stopped; no child result lifecycle existed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results and continued local tool/test iterations until timeout.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a local background-task interruption, but not a subagent result lifecycle; serial's terminal lifecycle was ordinary local debug cancellation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote multiple package files into one workspace but no concurrent writer or merge appeared.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote its own package files into one workspace with no concurrent writer or merge.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were single-writer workspaces in practice; parallel did not create cross-agent shared-state risk because no child ran.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel performed target-binary probes but did not reach working reimplementation tests before compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial performed target-binary probes and local primitive tests, but tests still failed before compile failure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial had stronger local verification effort, but neither reached evaluator-aligned acceptance or a compiling final artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed its available run window, ended by cancellation, and the provider retry reason was agent_timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also consumed its run window and ended by cancellation after local debugging.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both were budget-limited failures; parallel's shorter effective attempt included a provider retry before the timed-out attempt, while serial had one longer serial attempt.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The official completed evaluations are aligned rather than discordant: both parallel and serial failed with compile_failed and 0/839 tests passed. The concrete task-solving difference is process depth, not outcome: parallel entered swarm mode and prepared stubs for delegated package work without executing any child agent, while serial stayed single-agent and progressed farther into real primitive code and failing local tests.
parallel_contributors: Parallel did not execute AgentSwarm or subagent work despite planning it, so its implementation stayed at scaffold and stub level before timeout.
A hanging pty background probe was stopped, leaving less time for implementation and no integrated verification.
serial_contributors: Serial performed more direct implementation and testing but still timed out with failing crypto primitive tests and no complete CLI.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel's files were primarily TODO-bearing skeleton packages, while serial's were partial but concrete primitive implementations.
Both failures are ordinary incompletion and compile/build failure, not a proven parallel coordination failure.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative explanation without outcome differential
